attributes.title: ENRS 39th Annual Scientific Sessions
attributes.summary:
The Eastern Nursing Research Society holds its 39th Annual Scientific Sessions from March 31 to April 2, 2027, at the Loews Philadelphia Hotel. The theme is "Forging Bridges: Connecting to Advance Nursing Science in a Changing Research Landscape." The meeting serves nurse scientists, faculty, doctoral students and research-minded clinicians, largely from the Northeast and Mid-Atlantic.

The keynote speaker listed on the conference site is Angela Frederick Amar, PhD, RN, dean of NYU Rory Meyers College of Nursing. Registration is open on the conference website. Full-conference early-bird rates, valid until February 11, 2027, are $545 for members, $655 for non-members and $350 for student members; from February 12 to March 6 they rise to $655, $765 and $450. One-day rates for Thursday or Friday are also listed. Refunds less a $75 fee are available for cancellations received by March 5, 2027. The Loews room block starts at $269 per night plus taxes until March 8, 2027. Contact hours were not shown on the pages we checked.
